If the patients with baseline QC failures are systematically different (e.g., more severe, older, or less likely to respond), then the reported response fraction among control-arm moderate-severity patients is no longer representative of the full intended population. This undermines the validity of the result unless we can justify that the exclusion does not bias the estimate.
